column2: [intro]
When I close my eyes, I start to soar,
In my mind, it's a wild ride, I swear.
Ideas burst forth, without a word,
I get lost in my dreams, and I don’t care.
In my mind, it’s a show,
Crazy ideas and whimsical thoughts flow.
And I think it's just grand,
Getting lost in my head, it's cool, man!
I imagine a world so magical,
Unicorns dance with penguins, fantastical.
I even met a fantastic llama,
In my mind, everything turns to drama.
In my mind, it’s a show,
Crazy ideas and whimsical thoughts flow.
And I think it's just grand,
Getting lost in my head, it's cool, man!
